construction_boundary_policy: Package initializers and their anonymous function bodies are inventoried separately with exact typed call anchors. They are not attributed to an operation function or counted as SOURCE coverage. Source tables/cached table builders are required data dependencies; the reviewer must assess these constructor boundaries alongside dynamic operation callbacks.
dynamic_boundary_policy: Function-value calls are not treated as statically resolved. Host methods are covered by immutable VFS fixtures; collection predicates/comparators/visitors execute through their enclosing required source function. Checker/content-mapper/project-reference callback domains remain explicitly excluded.
